blocks.text: Precise one-click AI background removal for product photos

remove.bg does one thing and does it precisely: it isolates a subject from its background in seconds. For apparel and product photography, that means a clean garment cutout with accurate edge detection, ready to composite into a ghost-mannequin shot, a staged scene, or a marketplace listing.

It is the utility layer underneath more elaborate tools. A clean transparent PNG from remove.bg is often the input another tool, such as a scene generator or a ghost-mannequin compositor, needs to produce a polished final image.
Precise subject isolation even around fine details like fabric edges
Clean cutouts ready to composite into other scenes
Bulk background removal via API for catalog-scale workflows
When a garment cutout needs to be clean enough to composite elsewhere, remove.bg's edge detection is the most reliable option we have tested for apparel photography prep work.
Our team can integrate remove.bg into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
